 Odisha School Holidays News 2026: Schools Closed Due to Cyclone Arnab, Check Districts
 Odisha state government declared holidays for schools, colleges, and Anganwadi centres across six vulnerable districts on October 28 and October 29, 2026. This administrative decision serves as a precautionary safety measure against Cyclone Arnab over the Bay of Bengal. The closure order applies strictly to the specified districts and not statewide.

 Cyclone Arnab: Latest school holiday updates 
 Odisha School Holidays News 2026: The  Odisha State Government has announced that schools are closed on October 28 and October 29, 2026, due to the safety measures taken against Cyclone Arnab over the Bay og Bengal. It is applicable only to the specified districts expected to be affected due to the cyclone in the region.
 Odisha state affected regions include the coast between Bapatla and Visakhapatnam, close to Yanam. The weather system is forecast to intensify into a severe cyclonic storm. Those monitoring the Cyclone Arnab path and live satellite data should prepare for adverse coastal conditions and heavy rain.

 Schools Closed Due to Cyclone Arnab, Check Districts
 The state government issued closure directives for six specific districts located near the storm's path. As confirmed in the official bulletin, the order does not mandate a statewide holiday.
 Educational institutions, including schools, colleges, and Anganwadi centres, will remain shut on October 28 and 29, 2026, across the following six districts:
 Ganjam
 Gajapati
 Rayagada
 Malkangiri
 Koraput

 Safety Guidelines for Students and Parents
 Students and guardians must follow essential precautions during the cyclonic event. Anyone following Cyclone Arnab live updates should observe these safety measures. Follow the government updates on the cyclone's real-time conditions. Keep the checklist of the guidelines regarding the safety measures carefully during the cyclone condition in the area. It is for the safety of the citizens. 
 Check official school communications and messages before leaving home.
 Follow continuous weather bulletins issued by the IMD and district administrations.
 Avoid waterlogged roads, flooded streets, and overflowing streams.
 Stay clear of coastal areas and beaches during rough sea warnings.
 Avoid unnecessary outdoor travel during periods of heavy downpours and gale-force winds.
 Rely on verified Arnab cyclone emergency resources and follow local disaster management instructions.
 Cyclone Arnab: Latest school holiday updates
 The latest Cyclone Arnab news shows that the storm has already crossed the Andhra Pradesh coast, but its effects are still being felt in Odisha. Heavy rainfall and strong winds may continue in parts of the state. The IMD has warned of difficult weather conditions in southern Odisha and nearby areas.
 For Cyclone Arnab live updates, parents should check official weather bulletins and district notices regularly. The Cyclone Arnab path and its effects can change as the weather system moves inland.
 Students should not assume that a school is closed only because there is bad weather nearby. A holiday is valid only when the school, district administration or state government issues an official closure notice.

 Odisha School Closures Due to Cyclone Arnab FAQs
 Which districts announced school closures 2026 due cyclone Arnab in Odisha?
 Educational institutions remain closed on October 28 and 29, 2026, across six districts: Ganjam, Gajapati, Rayagada, Malkangiri, Koraput, and Nabarangpur. Does the holiday order apply to all educational institutions across Odisha?
 No, the closure order does not apply statewide. It is effective only in the six specified vulnerable districts, while institutions in other districts operate according to their local administrative guidelines. Where is Arnab cyclone now?
 Cyclone Arnab crossed the Andhra Pradesh and Yanam coast early on October 28. It weakened after landfall, but rain and strong winds are still affecting nearby areas. Where can students check Cyclone Arnab updates?
 Students and parents should check official IMD weather bulletins, district administration notices and school messages for the latest information. Have questions about your prep?
